title: Learn how the venture supports its customers

steps.do: Read the support policy, open cases, customers, open bugs and any helpdesk connection, and list what is missing, most needed first.
Ask the founder where customers reach the venture, when each channel is answered and how fast a first reply should come, and draft the support policy's channels and targets.
Ask when a customer gets a refund or credit and up to how much, and what must always go to a person, and add it to the draft policy.
Ask which customer questions, problems or complaints are open now, and write one case for each, tagged with a contact reason.
Tell the founder how many cases are open, which are past the response target, which are complaints, and the most common contact reasons, each count citing the cases.

done_criteria.check: Is the support policy drafted for the founder with channels, targets and a refund rule, and does every open contact the founder named have a case with a kind, a reason and a status?
